goal: Deepen flagship 6: a second paid scheduler's shifts import with no CSV
notes: Built from When I Work's published OpenAPI 3.1 file (SHA-256 in eval note). Key difference from 7shifts: RFC 2822 times carry their offset, so the digits are the wall clock; length computed from instants (DST night shift = 8 h). Local: node --test import-wheniwork, import-7shifts, page, cli, import-shifts: 88 pass 0 fail; headless Chromium upload of 3 JSON files filled the shifts box, listed both locations, location pick worked, no page errors. Full venture suite and venture-preflight results in the PR body. Not run on a real When I Work account or recorded response. Homebase API docs answered 401 without an account.
